'''Danil''' is an infant born during the [[Aiel War]]. It is presumed he is Murandian, because the camp he was found by Moiraine in was Murandian.[1]

==History==
After seeing [[Susa Wynn]] receive coin from [[Moiraine Damodred]], Danil's mother tried to pass him off as sick to "see a Wise Woman." Moiraine saw through the ruse and offered [[Healing]], which Danil's mother refused.{{ref/book|0|5}}
